title: Unstable connection (totally unuseable) V3.1.0.2 Dana i (Samsung S20FE and Xiaomi Poco X3 Pro)
symptom: After moving from V3.0 with VP to 3.1.0.2 with Dana i, the pump has intermittent comms causing catastrophic failures: no treatment buttons, poor BG control, 'Large time difference', 'Application needs BT permission', 'No profile set', 'Pump not initialized, profile not set!', 'Failed to upload basal profile'. The user has been trying to connect for 5 days with poor control.
cause: The thread identifies that on Dana i there are two UTC settings, one in patient access and one in doctor mode, and adjusting the UTC in doctor mode resolved the issues.
fix: Enter doctor mode on the Dana i pump and make sure UTC is correct. Adjusting the UTC setting in doctor mode resolved the issues.
evidence_quote: Enter doc mode (video on YouTube with Advanced Therapeutics) and make sure UTC is correct
